name: Fat Pack | 1.5g Preroll | Deep Fried Ice Cream
description: Fat J: 1.5 Gram Preroll - a half gram better. A decadent cross of Ice Cream Cake x Deep Breath, Deep Fried Ice Cream delivers a rich dessert-like profile layered with sweet vanilla and fried dough notes. The effects lean into a relaxing body high paired with a euphoric mental lift, making it perfect for unwinding after a long day. Dominant terpenes like Caryophyllene, Limonene, and Myrcene bring depth and balance to the flavor.
